extDescription.message: Shares individual tabs with your AI agent; the connection runs through your own relay.

actionTitle.message: Agent Tabs: share / revoke this tab

overlayBar.message: The agent is controlling this tab

askText.message: The agent wants to act on $HOST$

optEnabled.message: Enabled (off: the agent cannot do anything in the browser)

optActionsHelp.message: The agent may read anywhere in its tabs. Clicking, typing and forms only with permission.

optBlockedHelp.message: The agent may do nothing here, not even read (subdomains included).

pairTitle.message: The agent wants to use a browser

pairText.message: Use this browser for the agent? Click Connect in the browser the agent should work in.

optBrowserNameHelp.message: Shown to the agent when several browsers are connected to the relay (e.g. Desktop, Laptop).

looseText.message: A settings change wants to allow: $LIST$. Confirm only if you made this change yourself (e.g. in your agent's settings).

looseEnabled.message: Turn on the agent in the browser

optSafetyHelp.message: How much the agent may do in its tabs. Changing a single switch makes it a custom setting.

safety_passwords_desc.message: Typing into password fields. The agent can then enter credentials that are in the chat or its context.

warnLoosen.message: The agent gets more rights: $LIST$. Continue?

warnPasswords.message: Caution: the agent can then enter credentials that are in the chat or its context – for example passwords you told it or that it read somewhere. Turn this on only if the agent should sign in for you.

tamperTitle.message: The page is hiding the agent overlay

tamperText.message: $HOST$ keeps removing the agent overlay, so you may not see what the agent does in the tab. If in doubt, stop it with the toolbar icon.
